upstream_sources.purpose: Independently implemented text formats from the dependency pinned by Nakama go.mod at v5.4.0.
v2.29.0 query parsing source comparison; no accepted gateway execution credit.
Go 1.26.5 gob decoder source and scratch observation provenance; not full Nakama server oracle evidence.
Go 1.26.5 RawURLEncoding source comparison; no accepted wire credit.

authentication: Verify signed candidate access principal and persisted active family before decoding business input; bind mutations and authorize requested read owners against that principal. Operator credentials do not substitute.

request_contract.top_level: write: objects array; read/delete: object_ids (objectIds) array; omitted/null/empty is successful empty operation
request_contract.value: JSON-encoded object string; retain its exact bytes for public MD5 version
request_contract.aliases: proto snake_case and lowerCamelCase; duplicate known fields/aliases fail closed; unknown fields ignored
request_contract.read_owner: Omitted/empty/null owner selects server/global UUID zero; explicit zero UUID is invalid. Nonempty owner follows pinned gofrs UUID string formats.
request_contract.list_query: Path binds collection and optional owner. Limit defaults to 1; supplied limit or limit.value is signed decimal int32 in 1..100. Cursor is an unsigned gob offset. Unknown query names are ignored; duplicate known scalars/aliases are rejected by this candidate. Gateway alias-map order, malformed wording and non-UTF8 behavior remain unqualified.
request_contract.list_owner: Omitted or empty owner selects publicly readable objects across all owners, including global UUID zero. Own owner selects read >= 1. Foreign and explicit zero UUID owners select read = 2. Nonempty owner uses pinned gofrs UUID string formats.

response_contract.write: Nonempty acks preserve request order and include collection,key,version,user_id as a dashed UUID. Timestamp divergence remains explicit.
response_contract.rejection: storage-specific code 3 / HTTP 400 for OCC, write permission or delete notfound/version/permission rejection; internal repository details redacted
response_contract.read: Return requested visible objects only; include collection,key,user_id,value,version and nonzero permission scalars. Timestamp, duplicate multiplicity and ordering differences remain unqualified.
response_contract.list: Return one bounded visible page with original value bytes, public MD5 version, dashed owner UUID and nonzero permission scalars. A next cursor identifies the last returned object only when a visible limit+1 sentinel exists. Empty objects and terminal cursor are omitted. No create_time/update_time is fabricated.

resource_limits.json_recursion: RawValue uses an iterative scanner bounded by request/value byte budgets; no 128-level recursion claim is made.

durability: Construct mutation success only after atomic committed receipts; construct read/list success after the bounded readonly repository transaction completes. Do not retry storage mutations or this client-list projection through the generic command supervisor.
migration_impact: No DDL or migration digest change in this tranche. Blind no-op handling preserves the existing legacy updated_at_ms; upstream database timestamp precision and historical created-time gaps remain open.
rollback: Revert this route/codec/bridge tranche together; existing persisted storage remains readable by the prior repository. Removing routes is not an accepted production cutover/rollback.
limitations: Existing epoch-routed Trillionnium session credentials and persisted family verification are used; Nakama token issuance/refresh/auth providers remain unfinished.
Write acknowledgements and read objects omit upstream create_time/update_time because the authoritative schema and receipt/object types do not retain these timestamps. No timestamp is fabricated.

List route/query/gob cursor and SQL client projection are bounded source candidates; exact gateway, gob, collation, pagination under concurrent changes and oracle/SDK qualification remain open. Search/index and Runtime before/after hooks remain unfinished.

Mutation/batch-read and internal typed-list paths retain duplicate-key, 100-operation and 128-byte/dot/control candidate restrictions. The separate client-list request accepts empty/dot/control collection text up to 4096 bytes and decodes authoritative Unicode-character-bounded rows. Budgets and path/query restrictions still differ from upstream.
Invalid/uppercase opaque OCC versions and exact gateway decoder details still require pinned differential; error bodies and headers are not globally qualified.
No durable command receipt exists for storage mutations. An ambiguous commit must not be blindly retried; reconciliation remains open.
Local mocks and source assertions do not establish PostgreSQL/CockroachDB durability, official SDK compatibility, immutable-oracle parity or independent acceptance.
Strict trailing-JSON rejection and malformed protobuf-JSON decoder error wording differ from the single-Decode upstream gateway and need immutable-oracle qualification.

Batch read uses bounded per-key statements in one readonly transaction, while upstream chooses a single query shape. Duplicate multiplicity, returned ordering and concurrency behavior require immutable differential.
Quoted integer trailing-token forms such as permissionRead:"1 true" are rejected; the pinned decoder can consume the first number token. Exact malformed decoder parity remains open.
Blind no-op selection is implemented, but legacy updated_at_ms is an explicit caller time rather than the pinned upstream database create_time/update_time contract.

Unsigned Nakama cursor offsets deliberately differ from the internal authenticated scope-bound cursor profile. Independent security/protocol review and immutable differential remain required; malformed gob and query errors are not globally qualified.
read_repository: One bounded readonly serializable batch under the pooled database deadline. Missing/ACL-hidden rows are omitted before decoding; data-integrity or SQL errors fail the batch. No generic retry.

validation_source.execution_required: Require TRNM_REQUIRE_LIVE_DATABASE=1, exact test result count of one and matching success marker; zero/missing/optional-skip results fail closed.
validation_source.scope: Canonical Rust HTTP application + actual repository SQL, with a separate exact client-list projection fixture on each profile. TCP, pool/deadline, SDK and immutable oracle are separate obligations.
validation_source.client_list_execution_required: The same live harness requires TRNM_REQUIRE_LIVE_DATABASE=1, one exact authority_storage repository test with zero failed/ignored, matching nakama_client_list_projection_executed profile marker, explicit skip rejection and a sealed nakama-client-list-projection.log. Source checks and local results do not admit exact-object live or independent evidence.

mutation_repository: Authorization, OCC and stored integrity checks precede no-op selection. Blind writes with unchanged value and ACLs preserve the persisted update time; exact-version writes and value/ACL changes update it. Atomic batch commit still precedes success.

list_repository.transaction: One bounded readonly SERIALIZABLE query under the pooled deadline; no generic retry. Existing typed byte-order list remains a separate contract.
list_repository.ordering: Use SQL text collation: public-all ORDER BY read,key,user_id; own-owner ORDER BY read,key; foreign/global-owner ORDER BY key. ACL is applied before limit+1. Actual profile text ordering still requires immutable-oracle qualification.
list_repository.decoding: Decode returned rows only, verifying owner/key, original value bytes, SHA-256 and ACL while recomputing public MD5. Do not decode a sentinel or hidden row. The Nakama row factory follows authoritative 1..128 Unicode-character collection/key constraints and allows dot/control text; old typed factory restrictions remain unchanged.

list_cursor.format: Unpadded URL-base64 of ordinary Go gob storageCursor {Key string, UserID UUID binary bytes, Read int32}. Decode compatible field descriptors rather than a fixed type ID or prefix.
list_cursor.scope: Explicit Nakama client-profile exception: cursor is an unsigned untrusted position without actor, owner, collection, profile or project binding. SQL always applies the current authenticated principal ACL. The internal typed list keeps its scope-bound cursor contract.
list_cursor.ignored_fields: Public-all ignores cursor Read; own-owner ignores cursor UserID; foreign/global-owner ignores both Read and UserID. Arbitrary int32 Read and empty Key are positions rather than identities. Clear the next cursor when its literal encoding equals the supplied cursor.
list_cursor.qualification: Ordinary source vectors and scratch Go observations are diagnostic inputs only. Interface values, reserved metadata value types, multi-kind or unknown wire descriptors, invalid UTF-8 Go strings, stronger budgets and exact encoder/wire behavior remain unqualified.
